title: My Week and My Favorite Month
text: My favorite day is Saturday because I do not have school. My family has a big calendar in the kitchen, and we write our plans on it every week. Our school year starts in September and ends in June. My birthday is in December, so winter is my favorite time of year. There are twelve months in a year, but December is always the most exciting one for me!
